halloween.text: Carve pumpkins, hear the ghost say Boo, fly the witch's broom and feed the monster candy.

farm.text: The hen lays an egg that hatches, apples drop from the tree and the tractor drives off.

playground.text: Slides and swings, bubbles to pop, balloons that change color and a puppy who fetches.

beach.text: Knock down the sandcastle, watch turtle eggs hatch and catch a wave with the surfer.

zoo.text: Shake the banana tree for the monkey, feed the penguin a fish and hear the lion roar.

construction.text: Dig, dump and lift, build a tower floor by floor and help the site dog find a bone.

space.text: Blast off in the rocket, beam things up with the UFO and say hello to a friendly alien.
